cases.text: A fictional flood damage report names the sterile facility and its loss of operating capacity.
A fictional power outage report names the interrupted fill-finish occurrence.
A fictional supplier suspension report names the affected provider-dependent supply relation.
A preventive assessment scopes a sole-supplier dependency before any incident is asserted.
A prospective quality assessment scopes facility contamination controls.
A review evaluates a proposed alternative-supply plan without claiming its execution.
An assessment names the manufacturing occurrence being reviewed; its report is a separate output.

interpretation: ICH supports considering diverse quality-risk contexts; it does not prescribe these classes, OWL ranges or fictional facts. Target lists are deliberately non-exhaustive.
